name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so knees line up with the pivot and the lower roller rests above the heels.
Secure the thigh pad and keep the back against the support.
Bend the knees to draw the roller under the seat.
Return slowly without letting the stack slam.
cues: Curl through the knees with smooth tension.
mistakes: Lifting the hips away from the pad.
Using a load that prevents a controlled return.
breathing: Exhale as you curl; inhale as you extend.
